namespace = ages_of_eu
namespace = abm_focus_picks

# Ars Belli: same-name replacement of vanilla in_game/events/ages.txt (listed in replaced_files.txt).
# GENERATED by .tools/scripts/focus_picks/generate_focus_picks.js - edit focus_data.js and re-run.
#
# Vanilla ages_of_eu.1 (fired by the hardcoded on_new_age) offered one adm/dip/mil focus via
# set_age_preference. That engine slot allows a single pick, so it is dropped entirely.
# Instead every age from the Renaissance on asks for two picks, each out of 3 branches:
#   ages_of_eu.1        - Economic pick (economy and diplomacy branches)
#   abm_focus_picks.1   - Military pick (two land branches + one naval branch)
# A pick sets the country variable abm_focus_<branch>; the advances of that branch gate on it
# (see in_game/common/advances/abm_focus_picks_*.txt). Variables are never cleared, so picks
# from earlier ages stay researchable.
#
# Both are country_event, NOT age_event: the age event window (eventwindow.gui AgeEventWindow)
# has exactly three cards bound via EventWindow.AccessOptionItemWithKey('adm'/'dip'/'mil') with
# hardcoded Administrative/Diplomatic/Military tooltips. Options without those keys all fall back
# to the first option (every card showed the same focus in game), so it can't list our branches.

ages_of_eu.1 = {
	type = country_event

	title = ages_of_eu.1.title
	desc = abm_focus_picks.economic.desc
	outcome = neutral

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = ages
	}

	# Age of Traditions has no focus picks.
	trigger = {
		NOT = { current_age = age_1_traditions }
	}

	option = {
		name = abm_focus_picks.court
		trigger = { current_age = age_2_renaissance }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = abm_focus_court }
		custom_tooltip = abm_focus_picks.court.tt
		custom_tooltip = abm_focus_picks.court.unlocks_tt
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.1 }

		ai_will_select = {
			value = 100
